title: GDPR obligations brief
brief: A plain-English brief on what the GDPR requires of a fictional French startup (Brume, SAS, Paris) shipping a companion mobile app for a connected air-quality device — user accounts, usage analytics, BLE device data, EU customers. Covers lawful bases, what counts as personal data in this stack, privacy-by-design duties, processor agreements and transfers, retention, handling user rights, cookies and trackers under ePrivacy/Art. 82 LIL, when a DPIA is needed, CNIL specifics, and a prioritized 10-item compliance checklist, with GDPR articles cited inline and a demo disclaimer.
da: Cool regulatory explainer: pure-white ground with cool gray hairlines, Libre Franklin headings over Inter body, indigo and teal accents, article pills in indigo tint, thin indigo left-rule callouts and disclaimer, crystal-clear numbered hierarchy, sticky 'what this means for you' side callouts, and an interactive prioritized checklist table.
